user.description: Choose a Ditoo Pro (DitooPro-Light) seen by Home Assistant's Bluetooth.

abort.already_configured: This Ditoo Pro is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No DitooPro-Light found. Turn off Bluetooth on phones that are connected to it and try again.

show_text.name: Show text
show_text.description: Show text on the screen (remote mode). Text wider than the screen scrolls.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Ditoo Pro to use. Needed only when more than one is set up.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Scroll speed in pixels per second.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds until the stock screen returns. Empty: stay.

y.name: Row
y.description: Top row of the 5 px high text.

start.name: Start
start.description: Where each scroll pass starts: right (text enters from the right edge) or left (first letter at the left edge).

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: scroll: the whole text scrolls. words: one word at a time; a word that fits is shown centered, a longer word scrolls.

word_seconds.name: Seconds per word
word_seconds.description: In words mode, how long a word that fits the screen stays.

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Show an image file (PNG, GIF first frame) scaled to 16x16.

show_native_text.name: Show native text
show_native_text.description: The device scrolls the text by itself with its own font, over the current channel; nothing is streamed, so it scrolls smoothly. Up to 64 characters. Ends after the duration, with Stop native text, or when a channel, drawing or text action takes the screen.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Ditoo Pro to use. Needed only when more than one is set up.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: 1 (slowest) to 17 (fastest), the device's own speed steps.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds until the text ends and the channel shows again. Empty: until stopped.

stop_native_text.name: Stop native text
stop_native_text.description: End the native scrolling text and show the channel again.
